node.title: Exact rate-half ordinary-list crossing at budgets one and two
node.statement: For every multiplicative-coset RS row with n=4d and k=2d, the ordinary worst-list crossing is exactly a_L=3n/4 for integer budgets B=1 and B=2: the exact-integer Johnson theorem proves L_1(3n/4)<=B, while explicit two- and three-codeword received-word constructions prove B<L_1(3n/4-1). Thus every official rate-half row with floor(|F|/2^128) in {1,2} has delta_L=1/4. No claim is made for B>=3 or for MCA/CA.
